Yes — that's right. Over in the Archive view, the bookmark's all there: its picture, title, description, its label, and the "View details & note" way in, so nothing about it was thrown away — it's the whole thing, just parked somewhere else. And back in All bookmarks it's genuinely gone from the main list, so my everyday library isn't cluttered by it. That's the "set aside but keep everything" behaviour I wanted, and I can clearly get to it whenever I like.

Two things left to close the loop on archive: that an archived one also stays *out of my everyday search results* — I wouldn't want it popping up when I search my normal library — and that I can pull it back out of the Archive to restore it to my main list when I want it again. Can we check those?
